plan_summary: Four-beat founder explainer: hook on repeated complaints, support overload, pattern recognition, and a practical roadmap lesson.
visual_prompt_boundary: This contract defines shot intent only. Session 9 visual prompt builder creates final image/video prompts later.

visual_continuity_rules: Keep one calm founder workspace across all scenes.
Use anonymized cards, notes, and roadmap shapes with no readable details.
Maintain soft daylight, warm neutral palette, and practical documentary realism.
continuity_plan.character_continuity: If the founder appears, keep the person generic and non-identifiable; hands-only continuity is preferred.
continuity_plan.text_policy: Generated assets remain text-free; any opening title belongs to renderer metadata later.
continuity_plan.factual_boundary: The founder, company, customers, and support details are fictional; do not imply real customer data or proven metrics.

caption_plan.overall_caption_intent: Frame the Reel as a practical founder habit: repeated support pain can reveal roadmap priorities.
caption_plan.cta_intent: Invite saving the idea before a roadmap review.
caption_plan.hashtag_intent: Later caption work can use founder, startup, product, feedback, and roadmap discovery tags.

asset_plan.image_video_policy: Scene 1 is an opening still/title-card background; later scenes need motion-friendly video beats.
asset_plan.provider_selection_policy: Leave final image, video, host, and render provider selection to downstream adapters.
handoff_notes: Give Session 9 concrete subject, action, setting, and text policy for each scene.
Do not create final production prompts in this contract.
Carry customer-data and music-license risks into review.

voice_line_map.line_text: The roadmap was hiding in the same customer complaint, repeated again and again.
voice_line_map.delivery_intent: Open with curious confidence and let the repeated complaint idea land.

voice_line_map.line_text: At first, every support ticket felt like a distraction from building.
voice_line_map.delivery_intent: Reflect on the early overwhelm without sounding frantic.

voice_line_map.line_text: Then patterns started to show up.
Three different customers were asking for the same fix in different words.
voice_line_map.delivery_intent: Emphasize that repeated pain became the decision signal.

voice_line_map.line_text: Support is not just where problems arrive.
voice_line_map.delivery_intent: Begin the lesson with calm authority.

voice_line_map.line_text: It is where priorities become visible.

scenes.narration_text: The roadmap was hiding in the same customer complaint, repeated again and again.
dialogue_lines: The roadmap was hiding in the same customer complaint, repeated again and again.

shot_intent.framing: Clean opening frame with one clear desk focal point.
shot_intent.subject: A generic founder workspace with laptop, notes, and calm work artifacts.
shot_intent.action: Hold a still setup that introduces the roadmap/support theme without readable artifacts.
shot_intent.environment: Soft daylight desk or small office with warm neutral colors.
shot_intent.camera_motion: No required motion; downstream may use a subtle hold or push if needed.
shot_intent.visual_evidence: The workspace and clustered notes imply support signals becoming roadmap focus.

scenes.transition_intent: Simple cut into the support-overload scene.
scenes.caption_intent: Set up the practical founder insight in one short idea.
scenes.music_sfx_intent: Warm piano or soft pulse begins quietly.
qa_focus: No generated title text appears inside the asset.
No readable notes, UI, logo, or customer data.

constraints.text_policy: No visible generated text; title is renderer metadata later.
constraints.factual_boundary: Only imply a fictional founder workspace and repeated customer pain.

scenes.narration_text: At first, every support ticket felt like a distraction from building. Then patterns started to show up.
dialogue_lines: At first, every support ticket felt like a distraction from building.
Then patterns started to show up.

shot_intent.framing: Medium-close desk detail that can move from scattered to more organized cards.
shot_intent.subject: Anonymized support cards and founder hands or workspace artifacts.
shot_intent.action: Show the support volume first feeling messy, then beginning to reveal repeated patterns.
shot_intent.environment: Same founder workspace, slightly busier than scene 1.
shot_intent.camera_motion: Gentle lateral move or small push that follows the card grouping.
shot_intent.visual_evidence: Repeated abstract cards represent repeated support pain without exposing data.

scenes.transition_intent: Match cut from scattered support cards into grouped notes.
scenes.caption_intent: Show that repeated pain is more useful than isolated requests.
scenes.music_sfx_intent: Soft ticking or desk texture under the warm bed.
scenes.tts_delivery_intent: (worried) Reflective, then slightly more focused on the pattern line.
qa_focus: The scene does not imply real customer data.

constraints.text_policy: All ticket-like artifacts must be abstract or blurred.
constraints.factual_boundary: No specific customer, product, or metric details are supplied.

scenes.narration_text: Three different customers were asking for the same fix in different words.
dialogue_lines: Three different customers were asking for the same fix in different words.

shot_intent.framing: Hands and grouped note clusters framed tightly enough to show the pattern.
shot_intent.subject: Color-coded notes or abstract cards grouped into one clear cluster.
shot_intent.action: The founder groups separate cards into one shared pain point.
shot_intent.environment: Same desk or board area with consistent light and palette.
shot_intent.camera_motion: Subtle push-in as separate notes become one pattern.
shot_intent.visual_evidence: Three separate abstract inputs become one repeated issue without readable text.

scenes.transition_intent: Push-in or clean cut to the roadmap planning beat.
scenes.caption_intent: Connect repeated wording to product priority.
scenes.music_sfx_intent: Pulse becomes clearer but remains low under narration.
scenes.tts_delivery_intent: (determined) Slight emphasis on the same fix.
qa_focus: No fake counts, charts, or metrics appear.
The pattern is visual without readable labels.

constraints.text_policy: No legible labels, numbers, or card text.
constraints.factual_boundary: Do not turn the repeated-pain lesson into a measurable result claim.

scenes.narration_text: Support is not just where problems arrive. It is where priorities become visible.
dialogue_lines: Support is not just where problems arrive.
It is where priorities become visible.

shot_intent.framing: Calmer final workspace frame with roadmap shapes arranged cleanly.
shot_intent.subject: Founder hands or generic planning board with abstract roadmap shapes.
shot_intent.action: Show the roadmap becoming organized from the earlier support pattern.
shot_intent.environment: Same founder workspace, less cluttered and more resolved.
shot_intent.camera_motion: Slow settling move or final hold.
shot_intent.visual_evidence: The organized abstract roadmap shows priorities becoming visible.

scenes.caption_intent: Invite the viewer to save the lesson for roadmap planning.
scenes.music_sfx_intent: Gentle musical resolution with no dramatic hit.
qa_focus: Ending stays educational rather than salesy.

constraints.text_policy: No readable roadmap items or UI elements.
constraints.factual_boundary: Only state the practical lesson supported by the fixture.

risk_flags.description: Support-ticket visuals could accidentally imply private customer details.
risk_flags.mitigation: Use abstract cards and unreadable artifacts only.

risk_flags.description: This stage could drift into final visual prompt writing if over-specified.
risk_flags.mitigation: Keep shot intent descriptive and leave prompt construction to Session 9.
